title: Recruiter Workspace
summary: A shared pipeline with notes, feedback and approval workflows.
headline: One pipeline the *whole panel* works from
lede: Recruiters, hiring managers and interviewers see the same candidates, the same evidence and the same next step. Nothing lives in a private inbox.

capabilities.title: Candidate Pipeline
capabilities.body: A board for every requisition showing who is at which stage, what they are waiting for and who owns the next move.
points: Two-way sync with your ATS stages

capabilities.title: Hiring Dashboard
capabilities.body: Open roles, time in stage and upcoming interviews on one screen, for a recruiter’s own desk or the whole team.
points: Filters by department, location and recruiter

capabilities.title: Team Collaboration
capabilities.body: Mention a colleague on a candidate, assign a task or share a shortlist with a hiring manager in one click.
points: Mentions and tasks tied to the candidate
Hiring managers review without a full licence

capabilities.title: Notes & Feedback
capabilities.body: Structured scorecards for every interviewer, collected before the debrief so opinions are formed independently.
points: Feedback hidden until you submit your own

capabilities.title: Approval Workflow
capabilities.body: Requisition, shortlist and offer approvals routed to the right people in the right order, with a record of who signed what.
points: Approval chains by role, grade or budget

outcomes.label: recruiter hours saved on every hire, on average
pipeline shared by recruiters, managers and interviewers
plans are priced by active roles, so the whole panel can review
